name: Anthion's Strange Request
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
We didn't realize the importance of Valthalak's medallion, so it was divided along with the rest of the spoils.  The first piece was taken by a dwarf named Theldren.  I tried to retrieve it from him and he beat me within an inch of my life.  You shall have to take the fragment by force.

Last I heard of him, he'd become a gladiator for the Dark Iron dwarves.  Getting him to fight you is going to present a bit of a challenge, though.

Gather the following materials for me.  You're going to need them.
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Dark Iron Bars, 20 Enchanted Leather, 3 Mooncloth and 4 Cured Rugged Hides to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent. I shall transmute these into something more suitable to our needs.
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you obtain the materials I asked for, adventurer?
